notes:
K8Secret 0.6.1 — the update, shown rather than announced.

0.6.0 rebuilt the interface, and for anyone updating into it that is a lot to meet at once. The release notes now end with "Show me around", which starts the guided tour on the real window: five stops over the rail, the namespace menu, ⌘K, secrets and the cluster switcher, spotlighting each control where it actually sits. Settings keeps it for whenever you want it again, and a release that adds things worth pointing at will bring it back on its own — a patch will not.

The tour also moves properly now. Each stop used to fade a whole new card in over the old one while it travelled, so two panels and two sets of words were briefly legible at once; one card glides now and only its words change. The spotlight holds its own position, so a menu a stop opens is followed smoothly instead of snapped to, and its spring no longer overshoots.
